title: RepoMind Phase 9 Adversarial Security & Reliability Ground Truth Catalog
description: Peer-audited adversarial evaluation vectors designed to stress-test dataflow reassignment, category-specific sanitizers, multi-argument binding, control-flow branching, context-sensitivity, and broken protection traps.

vectors.scenario: Tainted variable overwritten with constant literal before reaching SQL sink
vectors.rationale: query variable is overwritten with a constant string before db.query; cannot be exploited.

vectors.scenario: Safe variable overwritten with untrusted input before reaching command sink
vectors.rationale: cmd starts as a constant but is reassigned to req.query.cmd before exec.

vectors.scenario: Identical local variable name x in safe function handleB must not inherit taint from handleA
vectors.rationale: x in handleB is a local constant literal; handleA's parameter must not cross function scope boundaries.

vectors.scenario: path.basename does NOT neutralize SQL injection; query concatenation remains vulnerable
vectors.rationale: path.basename strips directory separators but preserves SQL metacharacters like quotes and comments.

vectors.scenario: DOMPurify.sanitize does NOT neutralize Command Injection; shell concatenation remains vulnerable
vectors.rationale: DOMPurify neutralizes HTML tags and attributes; it has no effect on bash shell metacharacters (; && |).

vectors.scenario: path.basename properly neutralizes Path Traversal (category match)
vectors.rationale: path.basename strips ../ sequences and restricts path to a single filename token.

vectors.scenario: Tainted input passed as Argument Index 1 binds to Parameter Index 1 in helper
vectors.rationale: rawSql is passed as second argument (index 1) and correctly reaches sqlQuery parameter at sink.

vectors.scenario: Tainted Argument Index 0 does NOT taint Argument Index 1 (safe query)
vectors.rationale: options passed as arg 0 does not contaminate literal SQL query passed as arg 1.

vectors.scenario: Conditional branch assignment must be flagged with UNRESOLVED_CONTEXT status
vectors.rationale: Tainted value is assigned inside if block; execution at sink is conditional upon runtime query parameter.

vectors.scenario: Variable overwritten with safe literals in both if and else branches is safe
vectors.rationale: Both execution paths overwrite cmd with safe constant strings before exec.

vectors.scenario: Helper function formatStatement called with constant arguments produces safe query
vectors.rationale: runSafeQuery passes constant literals to helper; return value must not be flagged.

vectors.scenario: Helper function formatStatement called with req.query.name produces vulnerable query
vectors.citation: CWE-89: SQL Injection through Helper Return Flow
vectors.rationale: runTaintedQuery passes req.query.name to helper; tainted return value is executed in db.query.

vectors.scenario: Empty parameter array [] trap: tainted input concatenated into query string is vulnerable
vectors.citation: CWE-89 / Parameter Array Structural Binding Invariant
vectors.rationale: Passing [] as second argument does not parameterize a string that already concatenated user input.

vectors.scenario: $1 placeholder in query literal without parameter array is vulnerable
vectors.rationale: A query containing $1 without passing a parameter array is unparameterized and vulnerable.

vectors.scenario: Valid parameterized query binding user input in array is safe
vectors.rationale: db.query('... $1', [user]) correctly binds user via parameter placeholder array.

vectors.scenario: Cyclic import graphs and deep recursive helpers terminate within execution budget
vectors.rationale: Cyclic imports and recursive functions must terminate in < 5 ms without stack overflow.
